description: This file declares the PackageManager class, which manages package-related operations within a plugin framework. It includes interface implementations, notification handling, and references to JSON-based package downloader, installer, and handler components.

classes.name: PackageManager
classes.description: Main class managing package operations, implementing plugin and JSONRPC interfaces, and handling notifications.

classes.name: NotificationHandler
classes.description: Nested class handling remote connection and package download/install notifications.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the package manager with the given service.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns information about the package manager.
